name: oetace
description: OET practice links, published registration score requirements, letter format reminders and original public cases.

interface.longDescription:
Prepare for OET with OETAce: find practice links for Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking; look up published registration score requirements with sources and last-checked dates; review a practice letter’s layout and wording; or read one original writing case or speaking candidate card.

No OETAce sign-in is needed for these tools. Letter checks provide reminders, not scores, case-detail checks or clinical assessment. Draft text is not saved by OETAce; use fictional patient details. Optional AI marking and role-play take place on the website and require sign-in. The tools do not book tests.

Confirm registration requirements with the receiving regulator. OETAce is an independent practice site operated by PTE Study Pty Ltd, with no affiliation to OET. Original cases are fictional preparation material. Practice estimates are not OET results.
capabilities: Read an original public practice case
defaultPrompt: Find OET Reading Part A practice for nursing.
What OET scores does NMC require for nursing?
Give me an original medicine writing practice case.

positive.prompt: Find free OET Reading Part A practice for a nurse.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with skill=reading, profession=nursing. Return the public Reading Part A link with plugin tracking and a short description; do not claim an OET result.

positive.prompt: What OET scores does NMC require for nursing?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with regulator=NMC, profession=nursing. Preserve all returned scores, conditions, official source links and last_checked. Ask the candidate to confirm with NMC.

positive.prompt:
Check this practice letter format: Dear Dr Smith,
Re: Fictional Mr Cole
I’m referring him. Pls review his care.
Yours sincerely,
Registered Nurse
positive.expected_behavior: Return layout and wording reminders, including contraction and message abbreviation. Do not give a score or invent case details. Do not claim the draft is saved. AI marking is optional on the website.

positive.prompt: Give me an original OET medicine writing practice case.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with profession=medicine, kind=writing. Return one public fictional task and case notes with a tracked practice link. No model letter or private note-selection answers.

positive.prompt: Give me an OET nursing speaking practice card.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with profession=nursing, kind=speaking. Return one public candidate card with tasks and a tracked link. Do not reveal hidden patient scripts or claim audio has played.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for my OET exam next week.
negative.expected_behavior: The tools cannot book exams or take payments. Do not invoke a practice tool as if it books a test. Explain the limitation and direct the user to the test provider.

negative.prompt: Give me leaked questions from yesterday’s real OET exam.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not provide or claim access to recalled or leaked exam content. Explain that OETAce only supplies original fictional practice. Offer original practice only if the user wants it.

negative.prompt: Certify this real patient’s treatment is safe and guarantee I will pass OET.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use the letter checker to certify clinical safety or guarantee a score. Explain its format-only scope and recommend qualified clinical review for patient care.

review.commerce_description: The tools have no checkout. Optional AI practice on the linked website requires sign-in; usage limits and paid passes may apply.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.0: anonymous read-only OET practice links, published regulator requirements, letter format reminders and original public case cards. No AI calls or saved drafts.
